title: ecg-glucose-benchmark: analysis code, pre-specified protocols and aggregate results for detecting hypo- and hyperglycemia from inpatient 12-lead ECGs
description:
Analysis code, aggregate results and analysis-plan excerpt for a study of hypoglycemia and severe hyperglycemia detection from inpatient 12-lead ECGs in MIMIC-IV-Ext-ECG-Glucose v1.0.0, with waveforms from MIMIC-IV-ECG v1.0. Models: demographics, ECG machine measurements (logistic regression and gradient boosting), a 1-D CNN trained from scratch, and frozen ECG foundation models with an L2 logistic probe (ECGFounder and ECG-JEPA, pretrained without MIMIC-IV-ECG; ECG-FM, pretrained on part of MIMIC-IV-ECG). The plan excerpt holds the TEST protocol and the pretraining-contamination protocol, each recorded before the data it governs were examined. Version 1.0.0 is released before the contamination test was run.

No data from the credentialed dataset are included: the scripts run locally on the PhysioNet releases and print aggregate tables only, with counts between 1 and 10 masked. Code: MIT. Notes and plan excerpt: CC BY 4.0.
